title: 画面を作る前に、方針をそろえる

source.what_it_is: AI-readable Markdown design guidance (SKILL.md files). Not a model, web service, screen-generation API, stylesheet engine, or five autonomous agents. The pin contains 24 skills; this example selected 5.

selected_skills.grouping_note: The 3 groups and 6 parts are explanatory grouping for this diagram, not an upstream schema.

source.this_example: The same original Claude Opus 5.5 model read the 5 skills plus the request and data, first authored design-plan.md (one-line design read), then in a separate authoring call used that plan to write the HTML/CSS/JS event list. The production operator separately ran 21 Node conditions and the actual browser. The original Opus did not run a CLI or browser. No human prior plan approval, no no-skill comparison, no measured usability improvement.

sizes.composition: three stage pills (渡す / 組み立てる / 使う) at top-left y=28, mincho title y=126 and sub y=170, diagram world 688x1028 at (16,200) using the tall concept layout (book shelf and request card on the first band; code sheet | one AI circle | 方針一行 sheet on the second band with the operator box below the code sheet; six ruled rows | result tray on the third band), foot line at y=1254

title/sub left, stage pills right, diagram world 1244x588 at (18,106) using the separate wide layout (shelf above request | AI circle with 方針一行 sheet above-right and code sheet below-right, operator under the code sheet | six ruled rows above the result tray), foot line at y=708

example_conditions.how: The IDs drawn are the return values of the unchanged events.mjs filterEvents, imported from its verified bytes at load time and compared with results.json, samples.json and concept/records/*.json before any control is enabled. Not animated fake outputs.

assets.gate: All 23 files are fetched once and size and SHA-256 are checked against the pinned manifest; structure counts, groups, filter facts and adjustments are checked; the 6 quotes are checked on their source lines; skill names, README (24 skills) and LICENSE (MIT, 2026 Mustafa) are checked; the 6 events, the 3 saved ID sets in results/samples/records (deep values, LF UTF-8 wrappers), the 21-check validation summary and source hashes are checked; events.mjs is imported from the verified bytes (blob: module) and filterEvents is called on a frozen copy of the 6 events for the 3 presets and 6 rule probes; the 4 capture PNG headers and sizes are checked. The captures are not drawn in the film.
assets.live_calls: None. No AI, no Node, no network beyond the same-origin asset fetch, no storage. Frames draw verified values and the in-browser function results only.

persistent_shapes: books: one shelf. Core book (dark cover, vertical 用途を読む), style book (closed spine with a seal mark that opens into a spread: paper/ink/seal-red swatches, mincho 明, one vertical line, seal), three slim helper spines 文字 / 操作 / 文言. Group captions 共通 / 表現を1つ / 補助3冊 (skill names as a second line in the wide layout).
request: card 依頼 with 誰に / 何を / 催し6件 and six coloured ticks — the six event identities (colour + day number) that persist to the end.
ai: one indigo circle AI with 同じAIが2回執筆. Copies of the five books and of the request travel into it and merge (inner fill). Never five AIs.

plan: folded paper 方針一行 written by the AI: one thick ink line (the one-line design read), swatches paper/ink/seal, pale ash #8A8378 struck to #625C53, 明 + ゴ, 10–11px to 11→14px, two rules and one vertical mark. A copy of the same sheet travels back into the same AI.
page: folded paper コード (HTML/CSS/JS) with indigo code lines and a six-row draft in the same six colours.
operator: umber box 制作担当が確認 with Node 21条件・実画面. The page sheet passes through it and leaves with a 記録 tag (a record of what was checked; no tick, score or quality mark).
rows: six ruled rows (colour tab, day number in mincho, title) unfolding from the delivered sheet; picked rows tint in their own colour, others fade but stay readable.

tray: native control glyph (対象 select or 検索 field), count in mincho, chips of the picked rows in the same colours, details triangle 参加方法 with the actual participation text, and two outputs JSON (saved record) and 実UI (desk.html).

scenes.title: 画面を作る前に、方針をそろえる
scenes.sub: Design Taste：AIが読むMarkdownの指針（UI生成APIではない）
scenes.conveys: What it is: books an AI reads, grouped into one core, one chosen style and three helpers. No UI or API image.
scenes.incoming: Empty paper; camera centred on the shelf (zoom up to 1.8).
scenes.events: Shelf appears (0.2-0.8 s); five closed books separate into three groups and captions fade in (1.0-2.2 s); the style book opens (2.0-3.0 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera pulls to shelf + request + AI (3.3-4.0 s).

scenes.title: 5冊と依頼を、同じ1つのAIへ
scenes.sub: 誰に・何を・催し6件。5つのAIではない (count read from events.json)
scenes.conveys: Instructions plus the real request (audience, use, six events, readability constraints) join one AI.
scenes.incoming: Books grouped and the style book open.
scenes.events: Request card (4.0-4.4 s) and AI circle (4.3-4.7 s); 誰に / 何を / 催し6件 underlined in turn (4.5-6.0 s); lines draw (4.6-5.0 s) and flow (5.6-6.2 s); five book copies and the request copy travel and merge into the AI (6.0-7.6 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera to shelf + AI + plan (7.6-8.3 s).

scenes.title: AIがまず「方針一行」と計画を書く
scenes.sub: 灰の文字→濃い灰、10–11px→14px（計画の上の調整）
scenes.conveys: The AI first writes the plan with a one-line design read. The open style book's ink/paper/seal/rule/mincho appear on the plan; the ash-text and label-size adjustments are shown as planned values, not as an executed before-UI. The same plan returns to the same AI for the next authoring call.
scenes.events: Plan sheet appears (8.0-8.4 s); write line (8.2-9.0 s); sheet flies out of the AI and its rows are written (8.7-10.6 s); ash swatch struck to dark gray and 10–11px to 11→14px (10.9-12.1 s); back line (12.0-12.6 s); a copy of the plan travels back into the AI (12.4-13.5 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera to AI + plan + page + operator (13.6-14.3 s).

scenes.title: 計画を使う次の執筆で、HTML/CSS/JSへ
scenes.sub: AIが執筆 / 制作担当が実行（Node 21条件・実画面）
scenes.conveys: Second authoring call turns the plan into code. A separate operator step ran Node and the browser; it returns the page with a record tag, no quality score, and is not rerun here.
scenes.incoming: Plan written; AI holds the plan copy.
scenes.events: Code sheet appears and flies out of the AI (14.0-16.4 s); operator box (16.2-16.6 s); check line (16.4-17.3 s); the page sheet enters the operator (17.0-18.0 s), waits while the box is lit, and leaves along the delivery line with 記録 (18.6-19.4 s); the six-row frame appears (18.4-18.9 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera to operator + rows + tray (19.6-20.3 s).

scenes.title: 同じ6件の行から、実際の関数が選ぶ
scenes.sub: 子ども→2件（e01・e04）・「短編」→1件（e02） (values read from the function results)
scenes.conveys: The same sheet unfolds into six ruled rows. The actual filterEvents results pick e01 and e04 for children, then e02 for 短編; chips keep the same colour identities into the result tray; participation opens with the real text (申込不要, then 窓口で申込（架空）). The finished UI is the endpoint, not the hero of the film.
scenes.incoming: Delivered sheet at the top of the rows.
scenes.events: Rows unfold (20.4-21.9 s); tray (21.6-22.0 s) and use line (21.7-22.4 s); children pick (22.2-22.8 s), chips (22.3-23.0 s), participation opens (22.9-23.4 s); tray fades and swaps at 23.85 s while rows re-pick to e02 (23.6-24.1 s); reading chip (24.1-24.8 s) and participation (24.8-25.4 s).

scenes.title: 使える一覧と、保存した実結果
scenes.conveys: Usable outputs: the saved JSON record and the native real UI. Pictorial only; no operating-system download happens in the film.
scenes.events: JSON and 実UI chips appear (26.2-27.4 s).

scenes.title: 本 → 方針 → コード → 使う
scenes.sub: Design Taste：画面を作る前に、方針をそろえる
scenes.conveys: Stable whole structure, understandable without sound.
scenes.incoming: All lines flow-coloured and emphasis back to full (28.3-28.9 s); camera pulls back to the whole diagram (28.2-28.9 s); title and stage pills cross-fade 28.5-28.9 s.
scenes.events: None. Still from 28.9 s to 32 s; poster at 31 s.

limits: Motion explains the recorded flow; it is not the original production's timing or an internal trace.
Only 5 of the 24 pinned skills were used. No same-request comparison with other style books, no no-skill comparison, no usability measurement.
The 21 Node conditions and the browser checks were run by the production operator in the original production and are not rerun here; the original Opus did not run them.
The original root-text 200% check is not a whole-browser zoom, real iOS, VoiceOver or NVDA check. No accessibility conformance or human approval is claimed.
The six events are fictitious. The poetry-reading title is event text, not audio; no audio is produced.
The 4 saved capture PNGs are verified but not drawn; the diagram carries the concept.

scope.original_production: Three saved Opus 5.5 authoring receipts: plan (design-plan.md), implementation (the list now preserved as desk.html with app.mjs, events.mjs, style.css), and the old 26 s film (video/legacy.html). Operator runs: 21 Node conditions (validation.json) and browser checks (verification.json, captures.json). None rerun or reassigned to this revision.
